description: This Java test source file contains JUnit test cases for the ConceptClassValidator class, focusing on input validation rules for the ConceptClass entity in the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: ConceptClassValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ConceptClassValidator, ensuring validation rules on ConceptClass fields such as 'name' and 'description' are correctly enforced.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfUserIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that the validator correctly flags the 'name' field as erroneous when it is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfDescriptionIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that the validator does not flag the 'description' field when it is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Tests that valid 'name' and 'description' fields pass validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptClassNameAlreadyExist
methods.description: Tests that duplicate 'name' values are flagged as errors by the validator.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Checks that fields within acceptable length limits pass validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that fields exceeding length limits are flagged as errors.
